state:
Goal `core-str-1-3`: 7 of the 13 members in `dossier-core-str-1-3` owe nothing. They are `Core\Str::after`, `before`, `at`, `contains`, `endsWith`, `countOf` and `compare`. Each has `about.md`, three examples with blessed `.out`, one attack, one bench with a `docs/perf/members.ndjson` record, and a Rust `#[test]` with its `covers:` marker in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs`'s `mod tests`. Their cards use the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. The other cards in the file still say "Answers …".

6 members still owe every proof: `chunk`, `codePoints`, `fold`, `format` (1 of 3 examples on disk), `fromCodePoint` and `fromCodePoints`. `bun nv proofs --verify --only <the check's 13 ids>` lists them. A new member's perf is recorded with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<id>'`, and `--run --only '<id>'` runs its examples and attack. Novis has no `===`; an example compares with `==`. `Core\Arr::sort($list, {comparator: fn(string $a, string $b): int => …})` is the sort with a comparator, and it is stable.
